item.backrooms_complex.threshold_key.too: Right-click a Hub Door to enter Backrooms Level 0
message.backrooms_complex.enter.first: If you accidentally noclip out of reality in the wrong area, you will end up in the Backrooms. It is filled with the smell of damp carpet, monotonous yellow, and the endless buzzing of fluorescent lights running at maximum power. Roughly six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in. And if you hear something wandering around nearby, God help you, because it sure as hell has found you...
message.backrooms_complex.enter.again: The Threshold — the end of your Frontrooms life, the beginning of your Backrooms life...
command.backrooms_complex.check: Backrooms connectivity check: %s connected air component(s). (more than 1 means disconnected areas)
item.backrooms_complex.wallpaper_hat.lin: A small-brimmed hat of the same material, brim gently curved
Hides a few blind spots and slightly slows sanity loss
Complete the disguise together with the coat
item.backrooms_complex.threshold_key.lin: A brass key with a strange tooth pattern, faintly warm
Opens the threshold into the levels
Your pass to the deeper parts of Level 0
item.backrooms_complex.wall_dust.line1: Fine white wall dust that crumbles at a touch
item.backrooms_complex.wall_dust.line3: Crafting filler, or to mark a trail
item.backrooms_complex.damp_canned_almon: A dented can of almond water with a water-stained label
Restores a little sanity and thirst, with nausea
item.backrooms_complex.bacteria_tissue.l: Translucent grey-black gelatinous tissue, still twitching
Crafting material, or a specimen to study
item.backrooms_complex.scraper.line1: A hooked blade scraper with a blackened edge
item.backrooms_complex.scraper.line2: Scrapes the carpet surface and collects fibres
item.backrooms_complex.scraper.line3: Gather carpet fibre; also strips flooring
item.backrooms_complex.canned_almond_wat: A pristine can of almond water, cold to the touch
Restores a good amount of sanity and thirst
The most reliable supply in the Backrooms
item.backrooms_complex.carpet_fiber.line: A coarse clump of fibre scraped off a damp carpet
Edible, but it badly damages the gut
Emergency food - at your own risk
item.backrooms_complex.lamp_off.line1: A fluorescent lamp with the tube dead, leaving only a grey-black shell
item.backrooms_complex.lamp_off.line3: The "extinguished" state of the lights during an anomaly
item.backrooms_complex.empty_can.line1: An empty can, a trace of sweetness still on its inner wall
item.backrooms_complex.empty_can.line3: Collect them to mark your path
item.backrooms_complex.wallpaper.line1: Yellowed, creased wallpaper still crusted with old glue
item.backrooms_complex.wallpaper.line2: Can be pasted back onto a scraped wall
item.backrooms_complex.wallpaper.line3: Repairs scratches on walls; also a crafting material
item.backrooms_complex.chisel.line1: A blunt old iron chisel, its wooden handle wrapped in cloth
item.backrooms_complex.chisel.line2: Turns plain concrete walls into patterned ones
item.backrooms_complex.chisel.line3: Change wall appearance, or recover chiselled concrete
item.backrooms_complex.unknown_sewage_bo: A bottle of layered, cloudy liquid that smells of rust
Restores thirst, but pollutes your sanity
A little better than dying of thirst
item.backrooms_complex.wallpaper_coat.li: A coat sewn from whole sheets of wallpaper - long sleeves, knee-length hem
Blends you into the surroundings and lowers the chance of being noticed
Camouflage for sneaking through the corridors
item.backrooms_complex.mycelium_carpet.l: A grey-black carpet of mycelium spreading across the floor
A dangerous source of biological contamination
